notes: Ferries (Istanbulkart) leave from Kabataş and Bostancı every 30 minutes in summer and hourly in winter; the last ferry is around 20:00.
There are no cars on the island: use an electric minibus, a bike or your feet. The Aya Yorgi climb takes 40 minutes; an electric vehicle costs 100 TL.
The islands are quiet in winter: the fish restaurants on Gülistan Avenue are heated and the beaches are closed. Istanbul residents come at weekends.
Try hot lokma, island ice cream and fish with meze; the restaurants on Gülistan Avenue don't need reservations.
ATMs are scarce on the islands, so bring cash.
Ferries between the islands take 15 minutes.

stops.name: Aya Yorgi Church
stops.tips: Take the 09:00 ferry from Kabataş, then ride an electric minibus from the pier or walk the 40-minute uphill path to Yücetepe. At the top you'll find the church and views over the Marmara.

stops.name: Yücetepe Kır Gazinosu
stops.tips: Köfte (grilled meatballs) and gözleme (stuffed flatbread) with a view, just below Aya Yorgi.

stops.name: Nakibey Beach
stops.tips: Closed in winter; walk the coastal road instead.

stops.name: Lunapark Square
stops.tips: A pine-shaded square in the middle of the island and the starting point for bike tours.

stops.name: Ali Baba Restaurant Büyükada
stops.tips: A long-established fish restaurant by the pier, serving meze and fish. In winter the enclosed section is heated.

backups.name: Eskibağ Beach
backups.tips: A pine-shaded beach on the west of the island, an alternative to Nakibey.

stops.name: Büyükada Bike Rental
stops.tips: Rent a bike behind the pier (about 300 TL/day); the big loop is 12 km.

stops.name: Büyükada Grand Tour Road
stops.tips: A paved road around the island, with pine forest and coves.

stops.name: Dil Burnu
stops.tips: A nature park for winter walks and views.

stops.name: Kalpazankaya Restaurant Büyükada
stops.tips: Fish and meze by the sea at Kalpazankaya; the sunset here is famous.

stops.name: Çankaya Avenue Mansions
stops.tips: Greek mansions and the John Pasha Mansion: wooden architecture.

backups.name: Kalpazankaya Beach
backups.tips: A rocky beach, an alternative to Dil Burnu.

backups.name: Lokmacı Square Büyükada
backups.tips: Hot lokma (syrup-soaked dough fritters) in the square.

stops.name: Halki Seminary
stops.tips: A Greek Orthodox school founded on the hilltop in 1844. Enjoy the garden and views; visits are guided.

stops.name: Çam Limanı
stops.tips: A winter walk with views over the bay.

stops.name: Heybeliada Meydan Balıkçısı
stops.tips: Fish at the Heybeliada pier.

stops.name: Naval High School Shore
stops.tips: The coastal road and Aya Triada; take the ferry back.

stops.name: Sait Faik Museum
stops.tips: The writer's house, and the literary heart of the island.

stops.name: Kalpazankaya Burgazada
stops.tips: A walk around the cove.

stops.name: Kalpazankaya Restaurant Burgazada
stops.tips: Fish and meze on the cove.

stops.name: Kınalıada Beach
stops.tips: The smallest island, with red earth and a seaside walk; you change ferries here.

backups.name: Aya Yani Church
backups.tips: The church on the square, an alternative to the cove.

stops.name: Princes' Islands Museum
stops.tips: The history of the islands at Aya Nikola, including their Greek, Armenian and Jewish heritage.

stops.name: Hamidiye Mosque
stops.tips: The mosque of Abdulhamid II, near the pier.

stops.name: Prinkipo Greek Orphanage
stops.tips: The largest wooden building in Europe (seen from outside); walk through the forest.

stops.name: Prinkipo Breakfast
stops.tips: Island breakfast on the square.

stops.name: Phaeton Square
stops.tips: The old phaeton (horse carriage) square, now with an electric vehicle stop and coffee.

backups.name: Ice Cream Shop on the Square
backups.tips: Island ice cream; a light lunch.

backups.name: Aya Dimitri Church
backups.tips: A Greek church, an alternative to the mosque.

stops.name: Sedef Island
stops.tips: Boats are infrequent in winter; do the Dil Burnu walk on Büyükada instead.

stops.name: Sedef Island Beach Restaurant
stops.tips: Lunch on Büyükada's main square.

stops.name: Aya Nikola Shore
stops.tips: The island's east coast, with rocks and a spot to be before sunset.

backups.name: By Şükrü Restaurant Büyükada
backups.tips: A fish restaurant on Gülistan Avenue.

backups.name: Public Beach Büyükada
backups.tips: A free beach, an alternative to Sedef.

stops.name: Büyükada Pier Square
stops.tips: The clock tower and square, quiet in the morning.

stops.name: Pastry Shop Büyükada
stops.tips: An island pastry shop for breakfast and ice cream.

stops.name: Plane Tree Square Büyükada
stops.tips: A last stroll, then take the 12:30 ferry back to Kabataş.

backups.name: Pier Tea Garden Büyükada
backups.tips: Tea and simit (sesame bread ring) at the pier: a farewell.

backups.name: Gülistan Avenue
backups.tips: A street of fish restaurants by the shore.
